description: This file defines data models for a chat application backend using Pydantic's BaseModel. It includes models for sessions, messages, requests, responses, and error handling, facilitating data validation and serialization for API communication.

classes.name: SessionModel
classes.description: Represents a chat session with metadata.

classes.name: MessageModel
classes.description: A single chat message stored in history.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Incoming request payload to send a message to the AI model.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Response payload returned after generating a reply from the AI model.

classes.name: SessionCreateResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a new session.

classes.name: SessionListResponse
classes.description: Response holding a list of available sessions.

classes.name: HistoryResponse
classes.description: Response for a session's message history.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Error payload for standardized error responses.
